text:
Alex R.: quick check — proposing a go/no-go sync for release v2.3 on Tue Jan 27 14:00 UTC. Cut date = Fri Jan 24 EOD. Can people confirm availability and stakeholder reps? want PM, QA, SRE, Infra, Security in the room.
Maya T.: Tue 14:00 works for me. will the RFC/design review be required before the go/no-go or as part of it?
Alex R.: thinking: RFCs that touch infra/runtime need signoff beforehand; product/UX items can be covered in the meeting if it's just final acceptance.
Nate G.: @Alex R. I can represent PM. I'll capture acceptance criteria and any outstanding launch todos.
Sophia P.: QA: we're on track for a full regression by Thu. one flaky test (search ranking) might slip until EOD Thu — will update. Assuming cut stays Fri, QA should have a pass/fail grid ready for the sync.
Kevin S.: SRE: need to confirm canary plan — how long are we running canary before full rollout? also want a rollback window and runbook ready.
Alex R.: good call. propose 2-hour canary with metric thresholds: error rate <0.1%, p99 latency within +20% of baseline. rollback if >0.5% errors or p99 > +50%.
Li Chen: infra: we need final capacity numbers from the performance run. can we schedule perf run Mon? if yes, we can commit resources.
Maya T.: adding a short agenda so people know what to prepare:
```
1) Quick status (5m) — outstanding blockers
2) QA signoff (10m) — pass/fail grid
3) SRE canary/rollout plan (10m) — thresholds + runbook
4) Infra capacity/perf (5m)
5) Open Risks & rollback decision (10m)
6) Final go/no-go vote (5m)
```
Alex R.: pinging list of folks I think should be present: @Nate G., @Sophia P., @Kevin S., @Li Chen, @Maya T., Security rep? @security please confirm. If anyone else needs to be in the room (legal/compliance), flag now.
Nate G.: I'll loop in security, Jenna L., and legal if necessary. Jenna — can you join or send proxy?
Sophia P.: QA will post the pass/fail grid as a doc by Thu 18:00.
Kevin S.: SRE fine with the thresholds. I'll attach the canary runbook to the calendar invite.
Alex R.: calendar-bot: please create event if no objections by EOD today. include agenda + link to release checklist.
calendar-bot: Event created — "v2.3 Go/No-Go Sync" Tue Jan 27 14:00 UTC. Invitees: Alex R., Maya T., Nate G., Sophia P., Kevin S., Li Chen. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/1763007890
Li Chen: conflict for me at 14:00 — can we shift to 15:00 UTC? otherwise I'll send someone from infra.
Maya T.: 15:00 would work for me too. Alex — any objections to moving to 15:00?
Alex R.: OK moving to 15:00. calendar-bot: update event to 15:00 UTC.
calendar-bot: Event updated — new time Tue Jan 27 15:00 UTC.
Alex R.: thanks everyone. action items: Nate to loop security, Sophia to post QA grid by Thu EOD, Kevin to attach runbook, Li to confirm perf run Mon. we'll use the agenda above and aim to keep the meeting to 45m.
Nate G.: noted. I'll ping Jenna now.
Sophia P.: noted.
Kevin S.: noted.
Li Chen: will confirm perf run by EOD today.
Alex R.: closing thread — reach out if any new blockers. :thumbsup:
